sources.title: The Goods and Services Tax Act, 2009 (No. 6 of 2009)
sources.institution: Government of Sierra Leone / Sierra Leone Gazette
sources.coverage: GST standard rate (Section 14); zero-rated exports and vessel/aircraft stores (First Schedule); exempt supplies (Second Schedule)
sources.notes: Published as Supplement to the Sierra Leone Gazette Vol. CXL, No. 37, dated 20 August 2009. Full text (Act No. 6 of 2009), text-based PDF, not scanned. Sierra Leone's VAT-equivalent instrument is named 'Goods and Services Tax' (GST), not 'VAT'.
